name: Greater Stasis · Fire
primary:
An explosion at the aim point with a 5.37-block radius (does not hit you):
• Damage 4.5 ❤ arcane + 2 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Cold 144: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Arcane instability: −0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
